dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual narrowing of the 2D body profile from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light bluish-grey median intensity, consistent with sub-adult pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse dark-pixel clusters visible on the cranial region and tracing the length of the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the darker cranial/ridge pigmentation and the lighter lateral surfaces.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several thin, light-colored linear marks (rake marks) on the left mid-dorsal surface; one small white circular spot on the left posterior flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sequence of rhythmic, low-relief indentations and shadows defining a segmented dorsal ridge along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scratches/rake marks visible on the left lateral-dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, segmented texture along the dorsal ridge line.
